sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT (light from above, dim only inside a tunnel)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the left light sensor reads less than 30 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 30 %

nothing is ahead: it follows the line
